title: read says why a transcript is empty
notes: read reports a logged-out bridge browser as AUTH_MISSING (exit 3) and a chat the logged-in account cannot open as 'The bridge browser tab is not on a chat' or 'Chat not found' (exit 5), instead of one generic 'No messages found' error.
The compiled exe no longer lists doctor in --help; its error points at setup.
launch in the compiled exe no longer prints a misleading 'extension dir not found' note and names the next step (log in, then setup).
The plugin skill tells the agent what to do for each empty-transcript error.
